questions.stem: As the chief pediatrician in a regional hospital in India, you are called to assess a full-term newborn 16 hours after birth. The initial examination reveals no abnormalities, and you relay this information to the parents. However, the father expresses concern that the baby has not yet passed its first stool or urine. To address his concerns, how would you explain the normal time frame within which a newborn is expected to pass urine and meconium?
